description: A Python script for performing smoke tests on a FastAPI backend, including health check, OpenAPI schema validation, and CORS preflight validation.

methods.name: _get_base_url
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the backend from environment variables, raising an error if not set.

methods.name: _require_env
methods.description: Ensures a specific environment variable is set, raising an error if missing.

methods.name: _maybe_validate_env
methods.description: Validates presence of required environment variables for authenticated endpoints if SMOKE_VALIDATE_ENV=1.

methods.name: _cors_preflight_check
methods.description: Performs an OPTIONS request to validate CORS middleware configuration.

methods.name: run_smoke_test
methods.description: Main function that runs HTTP checks to verify backend health, schema, and CORS configuration.
